_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'COST ESTIMATING WORKSHEET' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.04.03.

f01_Role_Title_and_Headcount.label: Role Title and Headcount
f01_Role_Title_and_Headcount.guidance: Specific resource role, staffing level, and number of full-time equivalents (FTE).

f02_Hours_Allocation_and_Hourly_Rate.label: Hours Allocation and Hourly Rate
f02_Hours_Allocation_and_Hourly_Rate.guidance: Total planned working hours and authorized standard or contracted hourly billing rate.

f03_Total_Calculated_Labor_Cost.label: Total Calculated Labor Cost
f03_Total_Calculated_Labor_Cost.guidance: Subtotal labor expenditure calculated from hours multiplied by hourly rate.

f04_Material_or_Equipment_Item_Descripti.label: Material or Equipment Item Description
f04_Material_or_Equipment_Item_Descripti.guidance: Detailed description of physical supplies, hardware, server infrastructure, or licenses.

f05_Unit_Quantity_and_Unit_Purchase_Pric.label: Unit Quantity and Unit Purchase Price
f05_Unit_Quantity_and_Unit_Purchase_Pric.guidance: Required quantity and current quoted unit price per item.

f06_Total_Calculated_Materials_Cost.label: Total Calculated Materials Cost
f06_Total_Calculated_Materials_Cost.guidance: Subtotal materials expenditure calculated from quantity multiplied by unit price.

f07_Contracted_Service_or_Work_Package.label: Contracted Service or Work Package
f07_Contracted_Service_or_Work_Package.guidance: External vendor scope of work, milestone deliverables, or consulting package.

f08_Vendor_Pricing_Model_and_Contract_Su.label: Vendor Pricing Model and Contract Sum
f08_Vendor_Pricing_Model_and_Contract_Su.guidance: Fixed price, time-and-materials rate, or contracted service sum.

f09_Grand_Total_Base_Estimate.label: Grand Total Base Estimate
f09_Grand_Total_Base_Estimate.guidance: Sum of all labor, materials, equipment, and subcontractor cost line items.

f10_Worksheet_Verification_and_Audit_Sig.label: Worksheet Verification and Audit Sign-off
f10_Worksheet_Verification_and_Audit_Sig.guidance: Formal reconciliation verifying math accuracy and absence of duplicated cost items.
